title: 第25章 焰云藤第26章 神秘前辈
slug: 重生本统子教宿主当老六
content_zh:
陆沉拜别陆凯之后回到自己的房间里。
“苟系统，抽奖！”
陆沉急忙催促道。
9527翻了个白眼说道：“来了！”
随即把抽奖的大转盘放了出来。
路程双手合十，口中念念有词：“老天保佑，老天保佑！”
说完直接转动起大转盘。
“你对这个仪式还真执着！”
“心诚则灵啦！”
9527心里盘算着：“也不知道这个苟宿主这次会转到什么好东西，运气应该不会太差吧！”
忽然，苟系统像是想到了什么，抿了抿嘴，小声嘀咕道：“好像今天花费的运气也不少。”
然后在陆沉的期待下，那转盘的指针居然又停在了白色的区域：获得奖励：一块石头。
物品描述：一块坚硬的石头，可以用来砸核桃，或许也可以用来投掷。
陆沉瞬间崩溃地愣在原地，嘴角抽搐着说道：“什么鬼？我的运气是彻底用光了吗？为什么会是白色的？”
“那个，别这么丧气嘛！”
苟系统开口安慰道。
“苟系统，别说了，我知道我的运气用完了，你不用骗我了。”
9527尴尬地笑道：“其实，是你今天的运气用完了。
早知道我这次就不给你发布抽奖的任务了。”
“什么？你的意思是说我的运气只值一万六千灵石？”

“不，那颗豆子才是罪魁祸首。”
陆沉一拍脑袋，猛然想起自己今天还花四千灵石拍了颗红豆，随即把那颗豆子拿了出来，仔细打量了几眼说道：“这到底是什么？”
9527丢了个扫描，然后把屏幕推到陆沉眼前：“自己看吧！”
只见屏幕上赫然出现这颗红豆的信息：物品名称：焰云藤的种子。
物品描述：可以与之签订契约的神奇种子，经过培养，未来不可限量。
陆沉一脸疑惑：“焰云藤是什么？签订契约又是什么鬼？”
9527看着无知的宿主，只能无奈地说道：“还是由本统子来给你讲解一下吧！
焰云藤是一种有灵性的植物，只要用鲜血和它们的种子签下契约就可以得到一株藤条，它会随着宿主的实力提升而不断变强，成熟的焰云藤不仅可以帮助宿主战斗，还可以附着在宿主身体上形成坚固的铠甲，它们的强度和抗性十分优秀，而且只要不是被彻底毁灭，它们就算被切成小块，也能慢慢恢复过来。
最最重要的一点就是，它们可以吸收不同的火焰来使自身产生变异，从而拥有各种功能，所以才说它们未来不可限量。”
陆沉脸上写满了不可置信：“苟系统，你没骗我吧？照你这么说，它很值钱咯？”
9527闻言满头冷汗：“你用钱来衡量它可能不太恰当，这东西得用有价无市来形容。”
“那我岂不是捡到宝了？”
陆沉说着狂咽口水。
“要不你以为你今天的运气去哪了？”
“快教我怎么契约！”
陆沉已经急不可耐了。
“咬破手指，把血滴在上面就好了。”
陆沉立刻咬破自己的手指将血液滴在那颗红豆上，红豆瞬间散发出热气，种皮裂开，一条嫩红色的藤蔓迅速长了出来，两头都是嫩芽，没有根，大概有一尺长，像一条小蛇一样左右探探。
陆沉吓得后退两步，见那藤蔓没有恶意才鼓起勇气上前，试着打招呼道：“嗨，小家伙。”
但那红色藤蔓并没有理睬他。

“苟系统，你不是说它有灵性吗？为什么不理我？”
content_en:
Lu Chen said goodbye to Lu Kai and returned to his room.
"Gou System, draw a lottery!"
Lu Chen urged.
9527 rolled his eyes and said, "Here we come!"
Then the big lottery wheel was released.
Lu Lu clasped his hands together and muttered: "God bless, God bless!"
After saying that, he turned the big turntable directly.
"You are so persistent in this ritual!"
"Sincerity leads to spiritual success!"
9527 was thinking in his mind: "I don't know what kind of good thing this stubborn host will be transferred to this time. His luck should not be too bad!"
Suddenly, System Gou seemed to have thought of something. He pursed his lips and muttered in a low voice: "It seems that I spent a lot of luck today."
Then, with Lu Chen's expectation, the pointer of the turntable actually stopped in the white area again: the reward was obtained: a stone.
Item description: A hard stone that can be used to crack walnuts and perhaps throw them.
Lu Chen instantly collapsed and froze on the spot. The corners of his mouth twitched and he said, "What the hell? Have I completely run out of luck? Why is it white?"
"Well, don't be so depressed!"
System Gou comforted him.
"Gou System, stop talking. I know my luck has run out. You don't have to lie to me."
9527 smiled awkwardly: "Actually, your luck ran out today.
If I had known earlier, I wouldn't have issued a lottery task to you this time. "
"What? You mean my luck is only worth sixteen thousand spiritual stones?"
"No, that bean is the culprit."
Lu Chen slapped his head and suddenly remembered that he had spent four thousand spirit stones on a red bean today. He then took out the bean, looked at it carefully and said, "What on earth is this?"
9527 scanned it, then pushed the screen in front of Lu Chen: "See for yourself!"
The information about this red bean suddenly appeared on the screen: Item name: Seed of Flame Cloud Vine.
Item description: A magical seed with which you can sign a contract. After cultivation, the future will be unlimited.
Lu Chen looked confused: "What is Flame Cloud Vine? What the hell is signing a contract?"
9527 looked at the ignorant host and could only say helplessly: "Let Ben Tongzi explain it to you!
Flame cloud vines are a spiritual plant. As long as you sign a contract with their seeds with blood, you can get a vine. It will continue to grow stronger as the host's strength increases. Mature flame cloud vines can not only help the host fight, but can also attach to the host's body to form strong armor. Their strength and resistance are very good, and as long as they are not completely destroyed, they can slowly recover even if they are cut into small pieces.
The most important point is that they can absorb different flames to mutate themselves and thus have various functions, so their future is said to be unlimited. "
Lu Chen's face was filled with disbelief: "System Gou, you didn't lie to me, did you? According to you, it is very valuable?"
Hearing this, 9527 broke into a cold sweat: "It may not be appropriate to measure it with money. This thing has to be described as having a price but no market."
"Then I found a treasure?"
Lu Chen swallowed hard as he spoke.
"Where do you think your luck went today?"
"Teach me how to make a contract!"
Lu Chen was impatient.
"Just bite your finger and drip blood on it."
Lu Chen immediately bit his finger and dripped the blood on the red bean. The red bean instantly emitted heat, the seed coat cracked, and a tender red vine quickly grew out. There were buds at both ends and no roots. It was about a foot long and poked around like a small snake.
Lu Chen was so frightened that he took two steps back. Seeing that the vine was not malicious, he mustered up the courage to step forward and tried to say hello: "Hi, little guy."
But the red vine ignored him.
"Gou System, didn't you say it has spirituality? Why are you ignoring me?"
